page.overview:
Who is Gerheart?

Gerheart was a planeswalker that was shortly mentioned in the Distant Planes anthology — part of Magic: The Gathering.

Gerheart had long, dark features, pale gray eyes, and salt-and-pepper hair and beard, with an incongruously youthful face. He must have been a considerate man because he gave forward warning that he would summon the sun priest Koborah, who luckily survived the encounter. !Title!!Author!!Publishing date!!Set!!Setting (plane)!!Featuring
